newsitem.title: ISRAEL: PLO police arrest Islamic Jihad men in Bethlehem.
newsitem.headline: PLO police arrest Islamic Jihad men in Bethlehem.

text.p: Palestinian police said on Monday they had arrested five activists of the Islamic Jihad organisation in the West Bank town of Bethlehem.
"The activists were arrested on Sunday night," said a police official. He declined to discuss details of the arrests.

Israeli security authorities have warned that Islamic Jihad guerrillas may try to mark the anniversary of the killing of their leader Fathi Shqaqi in Malta last October 26 by carrying out a retaliatory strike against the Jewish state.
Israel's Mossad espionage agency is widely suspected to have been involved in the Shqaqi killing.
